source:
Approved Layout 4 artifact b9eadbd4-e165-4de9-884d-86acc9fbf2a2 ("SAOC Menu Flyouts"), verbatim

text inside the .dd4__feature block, re-read and grepped from the published artifact HTML on 2026-09-10 (line ~514 of the saved artifact export: `

Day, weekend and VIP admission for the 19th National Show.

`, immediately following the

Tickets

heading).
provenanceRuling: This string is menu CHROME copy embedded directly in Brad's approved design mockup, not a leaf descriptor. It is NOT covered by contracts/checks/menu-system-layout4-f1/check-descriptor-provenance.mjs, which is shaped specifically around leaf links whose descriptor must be a trimmed prefix of their own row's `purpose` field in content/national-show-routes.json — the feature rail has no manifest row at all, so that checker's provenance mechanism doesn't apply here by design, not by oversight. This string gets its OWN provenance check (contracts/checks/menu-system-layout4-f7/check-featurerail-blurb-provenance.mjs) tied directly to this golden file, which is itself tied to the artifact. F1's nav-config.ts comment ("featureRail.blurb has no source anywhere (mission, handoff, or manifest) ... never filled with a reasonable-sounding default") predates this re-read of the artifact and was correct at the time it was written — the mission's own section 1 table already listed 'one-line blurb' as part of the approved shape, but the literal text had not yet been extracted from the artifact's own markup. It has now been found, verbatim, in the approved mockup. F1's no-invention posture stands as the right call for anything NOT traceable this way; this string is the one piece of feature-rail copy that now is.
blurb: Day, weekend and VIP admission for the 19th National Show.
